name: Fanum broccoli throw
description: Throw and broccoli flies at the camera, with Fanum alongside.
origin: Streamer Fanum is handed a plate of broccoli and flings it back over his shoulder. The popular edit adds a huge explosion behind him.
whatHappens: A plate of broccoli appears on your hands. Fling it over your shoulder: it flies away behind you, and a massive explosion goes off behind you while you sit there, calm.
how: Hold both hands palms-up at chest height, like you’re holding a plate. When the plate appears, fling one hand up and back over your shoulder.
tips: The fling only counts once the plate has appeared, so waving around never triggers it.
